lines.text: Every lift must be properly planned, and controlled.
Only competent, authorised people may operate the machine,
Lifting equipment and accessories must be right for the load, and checked before use.
Never stand beneath a suspended load,
or anywhere you could become trapped.
The exclusion zone must be kept clear for the whole lift.
or the lift can't go to plan:
Plan it. Clear it. Lift it safely.
If an excavator is used to lift, it must be rated for lifting, and the load attached to a proper lifting point.
